title: Tutor chat during a tour — context-aware Q&A on the current step
spec:
Evan, 2026-09-04, while specing VSCode-LLM-Tutorial: 'I can ask a tutor (like sql-gauntlet and what repo-tour still needs btw)'.

A tour viewer who does not understand the step in front of them currently has nowhere to go. sql-gauntlet already proves the pattern: a right-side chat drawer (public/chat.js) keyed by context, holding one transcript per question id, with the full question context injected into the prompt and a POST /api/chat backend.

Bring the same to repo-tour, with the tour step as the context key.

ACs:
- A tutor drawer is reachable from any tour step without leaving or resetting the tour.
- The tutor receives the current step's context automatically (the step's code, its narration, the file/symbol it points at) — the user never pastes code in to ask about it.
- One transcript per tour step; switching steps switches context, and returning to a step restores its transcript.
- Answers are grounded in the actual repo under tour, not general knowledge — a claim about this repo cites the file it came from.
- The existing provenance-tagged note mechanism can capture a tutor exchange as a note, carrying the same which-step-inspired-it metadata as a manual note.

Out of scope
- Tutor during PR tours specifically (repo tours first) — deferred: who=human:evan why=v1 is repo-first per the 2026-08-25 decision
- Shared/multiplayer transcripts — deferred: who=human:evan why=single-user product today

2026-09-04 closed at intake (duplicate): Filed 2026-09-04 on the belief repo-tour had no tutor. It does: T-3 shipped the Ask panel (src/ask.ts, src/askpanel.ts) modelled on sql-gauntlet's tutor, with the current stop's title/text, the file, its digest meaning, the diff and the reader's notes in context. Two small gaps remain and are carried by the VSCode-LLM-Tutorial work instead: one transcript per stop (askpanel.ts keeps one history per page) — the extension keeps one per step (VSCode-LLM-Tutorial T-6); grounding claims by file citation — the persona already requires it. Nothing else here to build.
